_comment: Generated by mods-src/seraphhorizons/Roaster/tools/make_shape.py. Every element was made for the Seraph Horizons mod. Both levels' parts are in this one shape, the stalls of level 1 where the furnace of level 2 stands: a renderer draws the fitted level's. The fire's texture code is 'fire': a renderer may set it to ember while the furnace burns. Keep element names when editing: the rig finds its parts by them.
